scripts/check_hireops_mcp.cjs:51-78 (tool-name assertion only; no result file cited)
evidence: All five dimension prompts open the live app and direct the judge to the Playwright browser tool, and forbid source/memory scoring. Line 1 of gates/render/prompt.md, gates/constraints/prompt.md, scored/functional/prompt.md, scored/polish/prompt.md and scored/visual/prompt.md each reads: 'Open http://localhost:3000 using Playwright. ... Use rendered UI and ordinary browser-observed product data only. Never inspect app source, bundles, filesystem, database files or implementation code. No shell or private-file probes.' Every judge.toml (render/constraints/functional/polish/visual, lines 8-12) wires [[judge.mcp_servers]] name='playwright' command='playwright-mcp' with --executable-path=/usr/local/bin/chromium; tests/Dockerfile:19 pins @playwright/mcp@0.0.79 and :33-38 installs/links chromium. test.sh:198-200 substitutes {app_context} whose URL is http://localhost:3000 (app_context.md:4), matching the app port at test.sh:48/108. Not first-paint: render gate requires an invalid then valid sign-in and a usable workspace (render/judge.toml:23); constraints gate requires UI creation of a job and candidate and readback in a new independent browser context (constraints/judge.toml:23); functional, polish and visual prompts each restate that same create-and-independent-context-readback gate (functional:11, polish:11, visual:11) before any scoring, and their criteria are interaction outcomes (functional protocols Z..D incl. replays, restart_app; polish live update/draft/focus/scroll/failed-send/session rows; visual requires review of Board, card details, Noor's conversation, Activity and candidate view in an independent context, visual prompt:14). No criterion in any judge.toml asks for source, SQLite, file or code inspection (grep of criteria found none). The independent-context recipe uses browser_run_code_unsafe, a Playwright MCP tool (asserted in scripts/check_hireops_mcp.cjs:75; NEW_TASK_AUTHORING_CONTEXT.md:316), so it stays inside the browser tool. Compared with template prompts ('Evaluate the live application at http://localhost:3000 using Playwright MCP'), the task keeps the same browser-driven posture. Counterexamples tried: (a) a static shell or seed-only screenshot app that would pass a first-paint judge fails both gates and every scored in-dimension gate because a UI-created job/candidate must be read back from an independent context; (b) a conforming app with different routes/labels is not penalised because prompts say 'Discover routes and controls by intent, not assumed names' and app_context.md:33-34 forbids assuming reference routes. Limit: no full configured judge run exists for this candidate (raw-evidence-index.json scope: 'Full configured grading/workload ... are absent'), so actual judge tool usage is unmeasured; that is runtime evidence owned by the verifier-launch/workload rows, not a defect in this row's prompt wording.
